guestApi.naming: snake_case operations, typed keys, compiler-minted declaration identity
guestApi.status: proposed; no guest parser, lowering, or AOT implementation is asserted

actor.lifetime: admitted actor incarnation through completed physical teardown
actor.migration: persists across carrier migration, await, cooperate and actor turns
actor.access: actor-state critical-read/critical-write rules remain mandatory; storage does not bypass sealed state
actor.inheritance: never implicitly shared with other actors or restarted generations

thread.owner: physical OS thread or a specifically documented WASM worker
thread.lifetime: physical thread lifetime, not actor/task/request lifetime
thread.migration: not preserved across await or scheduler carrier migration
thread.access: host/FFI or explicitly thread-pinned effect only; forbidden as actor, request, task or tenant authority
thread.inheritance: no implicit propagation; carrier reuse can expose stale values unless host clears them

request.lifetime: request admission until logical revocation, with physical memory reclamation deferred until pinned children/borrows retire
request.migration: persists across authenticated continuations and carrier migration
request.access: bind to authenticated delivered mail and SourceTask origin, never actor-id/thread-local/callback provenance alone
request.inheritance: no implicit inheritance to detached tasks or unrelated actor messages
request.firstMailBinding: one-shot transfer token binds to first admitted original actor-mail sequence from its supervisor; same bytes in later mail cannot reclaim it

task.lifetime: task admission through physical completion/get_done and owned continuation cleanup
task.migration: persists across await, select, cooperate and carrier migration
task.access: only current authenticated logical task generation
task.inheritance: none by default; explicit child snapshots must be immutable Sendable copies with independent child ownership

crossCutting.keyIdentity: compiler-resolved declaration/module identity and instantiation type; neither guest integers nor foreign mutable aliases
crossCutting.readPolicy: snapshot/copy or correctly scoped loan; no mutable reference crossing await/FFI/owner retirement
crossCutting.typePolicy: compiler ownership and Sendable checks on any value crossing carriers/isolates; no untrusted host pointers or capabilities; strings must contain valid Unicode scalar values with no malformed surrogate/codepoint sequences
crossCutting.isolation: tenant+isolate+runtime domains and generation checked before every operation
crossCutting.retirement: revoke access before reclamation; do not run guest finalizers under storage locks or on arbitrary callbacks
crossCutting.capacity: configurable bounded slots and bytes; exhaustion fails without partial mutation; hard-RT native profiles preallocate
crossCutting.security: a storage handle, request id, ActorId, OS ThreadLocal, AsyncLocal, or callback payload is not authorization
crossCutting.aot: compiler-generated static key/type descriptors; no runtime reflection or dynamic source compilation
